inbox: Production volume published & target released (G01); AZForce open; offline OPEX templates to EF

steps.lab: Two parallel streams – FTE & manpower and non-manpower (OPEX) – merge into the Planning Hub review

steps.t: FTEs planned in AZForce
steps.d: Planners assign cost centre, grade, location, worker type and employee type to every FTE; phasing by start / end date (Employee Details form) or directly (Simplified form). Active FTEs = Authorised FTEs × (1 − vacancy rate); CY+2/3 FTEs kept flat. EF provides the FTE adjustments.
steps.sys: AZForce, Finance Control Tower (FTE report)
steps.src: LT feedback deck - FP&A Operations E2E Process Flow (Planning), Oct 2026

steps.t: Manpower and manpower-driven costs calculated
steps.d: AZForce calculates grossed-up manpower and performance bonus costs from active FTEs, average base salaries and HR uplifts, plus selected driven costs from pre-loaded assumptions (overtime, shift allowance, holiday pay accrual, Catalyze). Remaining costs are calculated offline and loaded.

rows.act: Agent reads the 9 site packs in SharePoint and drafts regional commentary. Baseline 31 hours a month; 9.5 hours delivered.

rows.t: Site-level insight on demand
rows.act: Ask Rhy for the key points per site, e.g. two executive summary points per site for the month, with source citations.

rows.act: Consolidates one named slide, e.g. Direct & Indirect Split, across all site packs into a regional headline.

rows.t: Keep business judgement as the final review step
rows.act: Analysts validate and refine every draft. The deck shows a wrong Wuxi capex driver corrected only after a challenge.

rows.t: Stabilise the agent before relying on it in close
rows.act: Stable in 3 of 7 test months. Issues: instructions ignored, missing site, usage limit, unknown errors, prior-month carry-over.

rows.t: Protect capacity for testing, refinement and upskilling
rows.act: 6 of the 9.5 hours saved each month are reinvested in learning and optimisation. Net gain is about 11%.

rows.t: Completeness check before the agent runs
rows.act: Power Automate lists the files found against the 9 in-scope sites and stops the run if a pack is missing or still in draft.

rows.t: Extract the numbers with Python, let the agent write the words
rows.act: Pull variance values by rule, not by the model. The agent then explains drivers only, which removes most accuracy rework.

rows.t: Tie agent totals back to the Ops P&L report
rows.act: Compare each category total with the Ops P&L Power BI figures and flag any gap before the draft is shared.

rows.t: Use the Site Cost & FTE dashboard as the source for cost and FTE numbers

rows.t: Period and version guard on the knowledge hub
rows.act: Check month and Final/Draft status on each file before reading, and archive old months so prior commentary cannot carry over.

rows.t: Trigger the run when final packs land
rows.act: Power Automate starts Rhy once all final site packs are in the folder and posts the draft to Teams. No manual prompting.

rows.t: Store the driver output as a monthly table

rows.act: Roll up each site's R&O table (likelihood, timing, $m) into one regional list. North Ryde alone shows $1.7m up, $2.2m down.
